pages.title: About Lift Tables
pages.excerpt: What this directory covers, where its specifications come from, and how it makes money.
pages.content:
Lift Tables is an independent directory of industrial lift tables, tilters and pallet positioners sold in North America. It exists to answer one question quickly: which models can do the job, and who sells them.

What's in the directory

The directory covers 20 manufacturers, their product lines, and the model numbers, capacities, platform sizes and travel published for each one, alongside the manufacturer's own brochures and owner's manuals.

Scope is deliberate: lift tables, tilt tables, pallet positioners and elevating carts. Dock lifts, vertical reciprocating conveyors, stackers and personnel platforms are left out, even where the same manufacturers make them.

Where the specifications come from

Every product line records the manufacturer pages, catalogs and data sheets its facts came from. Specifications are copied as the manufacturer publishes them and are not adjusted, estimated or filled in. Where a manufacturer publishes no model table, the line says so rather than guessing.

Manufacturers change their models and their literature without notice. Confirm capacity, dimensions and options with the manufacturer or distributor before you buy. If you find something out of date or wrong, tell us and we will fix it.

Not affiliated with the manufacturers

Lift Tables is not affiliated with, endorsed by or authorized by any manufacturer listed here. Every brand name, model number, trademark and logo belongs to its owner and is used only to identify the equipment being described.

Product photographs and PDF documents are the manufacturers' own material. Each is credited on the page it appears on and links back to the page the manufacturer publishes it on. If you represent a manufacturer and want your photos, documents or listing changed or removed, email tim@lifttables.us and we will act on it promptly.

How the directory makes money

Distributors pay to be listed and to receive quote requests for the brands and regions they cover. Buyers pay nothing, and a manufacturer cannot pay to change how its equipment is described or ranked in the catalog. Paid distributor listings are marked as such, and their outbound links are tagged sponsored.

Contact

Questions, corrections and listing enquiries: tim@lifttables.us. See the contact page for which address to use.

pages.title: Contact
pages.excerpt: How to reach Lift Tables about quotes, listings, corrections and removal requests.
pages.content:
Lift Tables is run by Tim Statler. Email is the fastest way to reach us, and messages are usually answered within one business day.

Buying equipment

For quotes, use the quote form, or the form on any product line page so we know which model you're asking about. It reaches distributors who carry that brand. You can also email support@lifttables.us.

Listing your company

Distributors and dealers: list your company to receive quote requests for the brands and regions you cover. Questions about listings go to tim@lifttables.us.

Manufacturers

To correct a specification, update a photo or document, add a product line, or have your material removed, email tim@lifttables.us. Removal requests are acted on promptly, and nothing has to be justified to us first. We are also glad to link to the literature you would rather buyers saw.

Corrections

If a capacity, dimension or model number here doesn't match the manufacturer's current data, tell us which page and what it should say. Corrections are checked against the manufacturer's own published source.

Privacy requests

To see or delete the personal information you have sent through a form, email tim@lifttables.us. See the privacy policy for what is collected and who it goes to.

Written correspondence

Lift Tables is run remotely and takes correspondence by email. If you need to send something in writing, email tim@lifttables.us and we will give you an address for it.

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.excerpt: What Lift Tables collects when you request a quote or list your company, who receives it, and how to have it deleted.
pages.content:
Last updated 21 September 2026.

This policy explains what Lift Tables (lifttables.us) collects, why, and what you can do about it. It covers this website only.

Who we are

Lift Tables is an independent equipment directory run by Tim Statler. Contact: tim@lifttables.us. We are based in Indiana, United States, and handle correspondence by email; write to that address if you need somewhere to send a formal notice.

What we collect

When you request a quote we collect your name and email address, and, if you give them, your phone number, company, ZIP or postal code, the equipment category you're interested in, your timeline, and whatever you write in the message. We also record which page you sent the request from, so the distributor knows which model you mean.

When you ask to list your company we collect your company name, website, your name, email address, phone number, the brands and regions you cover, the listing you're interested in, and your message.

Automatically, our web host keeps standard server logs, and your IP address is used briefly to limit repeat form submissions. Your IP address is not stored with your request.

We do not collect payment card details on this site, and we do not ask for any sensitive personal information.

Why we use it, and who receives it

A quote request exists to be answered by someone who sells the equipment. When you send one, we pass your name, contact details and message to distributors who carry that brand — up to three of them — so they can quote you. They contact you directly, and their own privacy practices then apply to what you send them. Until distributors are listed for a brand, requests come to us and we forward them to a supplier on your behalf.

We also use what you send to reply to you, to keep a record of the request, and to understand which equipment buyers ask about. We do not sell your personal information, and we do not share it with anyone other than the distributors handling your request and the service providers below.

Service providers

The site runs on managed WordPress hosting, and email is sent through Google Workspace. These providers process data on our behalf in order to run the site and deliver messages. Visit measurement is described below.

Cookies and analytics

Since 21 September 2026 this site uses Google Analytics to count visits and see which equipment pages people read. It sets a first-party cookie in your browser so a returning visit is not counted twice, and it sends your IP address to Google, which derives an approximate location from it and does not store it. We see totals and trends; we cannot see who you are.

Google Signals and ad personalisation are both switched off in our settings, so what we measure does not feed Google’s advertising profile of you and we cannot build advertising audiences from it. The site sets no advertising cookies and loads no other third-party script — our typefaces are served from our own server rather than from Google Fonts, so simply reading a page does not hand your address to anyone else.

To stay out of it, use an ad or tracker blocker, or install Google’s opt-out browser add-on. Nothing on this site is withheld from you for doing so.

WordPress sets cookies only if you log in or leave a comment. Forms use a short-lived security token to prevent abuse.

How long we keep it

Quote and listing requests are kept for three years so we can answer follow-up questions and resolve disputes, then deleted. Ask us sooner and we will delete yours.

Your choices

Email tim@lifttables.us to get a copy of what we hold about you, correct it, or have it deleted. We will respond within 30 days. Depending on where you live, you may have rights under laws such as the California Consumer Privacy Act or the GDPR, including access, deletion, correction and the right not to be discriminated against for exercising them. We honour these requests for everyone, wherever you are.

Distributors who have already received your request hold their own copy. We will tell you who they were so you can contact them.

Security

The site is served over HTTPS and requests are stored in the site's database, which only the site's administrator can read. No website can promise perfect security, but we keep access limited and software updated.

Children

This is a site for buying industrial equipment. It is not directed to children, and we do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 16.

Changes

If this policy changes, the date at the top changes with it. Material changes will be noted on this page. The most recent was on 21 September 2026, when we added Google Analytics; before that the site carried no analytics at all.
